text:
Sam B: quick heads-up — during the Apr pricing experiment we had a handful of customer invoices that were billed at the older tier but the accounting entry was booked against the new plan's revenue schedule. noticed this while recon'ing MTD usage. :grimacing:
Maria G: ugh — do we have invoice numbers or a list? can you paste the sample rows?
Sam B: pasted 3 rows below from the export:
```invoice_id,customer,period,charged_tier,booked_revenue_account,amount
INV-2026-0421,acme-inc,2026-04,legacy-pro,4000-REVENUE-NEW,12000
INV-2026-0467,beta-ops,2026-04,legacy-pro,4000-REVENUE-NEW,5200
INV-2026-0499,delta-apps,2026-04,legacy-pro,4000-REVENUE-NEW,3800
```
Sam B: looks like billing applied legacy rates but GL hit 4000-REVENUE-NEW (should have been 4100-REVENUE-LEGACY) — probably a downstream mapping change when we flipped the experiment.
Kevin R: ok — estimate materiality? for month-end we need to know if late reclass is required vs footnote.
Sam B: total impact ~21,000 recognized to the wrong account. not changing revenue amount, just account (reclass between revenue accounts). accrual/deferral schedule unaffected.
Aisha F: since this is account-to-account reclass, tax/mrr not affected, but we need AP/AR tie-out confirmation. can we run a quick AR aging for those invoices? @Maria G can you pull?
Maria G: pulling now. will post the AR aging rows in a sec. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maria G: AR excerpt: ``INV-2026-0421, 2026-04-09, $12,000, status: paid; INV-2026-0467, 2026-04-21, $5,200, status: paid; INV-2026-0499, 2026-04-28, $3,800, status: paid``
Maria G: all paid in Apr so cash already posted.
Kevin R: good — since cash is posted, preferred approach is to post a reclassification JE in May close that moves amounts from 4000-REVENUE-NEW -> 4100-REVENUE-LEGACY with memo referencing the experiment mapping bug. no deferral reversal needed.
Sam B: agree. template JE: DR 4000-REVENUE-NEW $21,000 / CR 4100-REVENUE-LEGACY $21,000. ref: INV-2026-0421,0467,0499. submitting for approval.
Aisha F: tagging revrec-bot to create reclass ticket and record in the revenue schedule audit log. :white_check_mark:
revrec-bot: created ticket RR-2026-0558 for reclass JE; assigned to @Sam B; scheduled for May close; please attach approval email and supporting invoice export.
Sam B: adding reason and approvals here: we need manager approval to post JE. Maria — can you confirm GL balances post-JE will still meet our revenue by-product reporting?
Maria G: confirmed — reclass only changes presentation between sub-accounts; consolidated revenue and ARR unaffected. i approve posting the JE.
Kevin R: i approve as accounting lead. please include the experiment run id and PR that caused mapping change in the ticket.
Sam B: thanks. will attach PR link and experiment id EXP-APR-026 and the CSV export. running the JE through approval flow now. :pray:
Aisha F: for the audit trail, can we also add a one-line footnote in the May revenue schedule: "Amounts reclassified between revenue subaccounts due to mapping correction related to Apr pricing experiment (RR-2026-0558)" — should be fine.
Maria G: agreed.
Sam B: final: posting JE in May close window, tagging close pack. if anything else pops up i'll update thread. thanks all. :thumbsup:
